message.content:
The Battle of Waterloo, fought on 18 June 1815, resulted in roughly **25,000 total casualties** (killed, wounded, or missing) across all sides.  In more detail:

| Side | Approximate casualties |
|------|------------------------|
| French & allies (Napoleon’s forces) | ~25,000 |
| Anglo‑Dutch & Prussian coalition | ~22,000 |

These figures are rounded estimates drawn from contemporary military reports and modern historical analyses.
